name: plugin-eval
description: Help engineers evaluate a local skill or plugin, explain why it scored that way, show what to fix first, measure real token usage, benchmark starter scenarios, or decide what to run next. Use when the user says things like "evaluate this skill", "give me an analysis of the game dev skill", "why did this score that way", "what should I fix first", "measure the real token usage of this skill", or "w

source.license_scope: repository root; per-skill license not independently verified

methodology.selection: Local-first supplement: authoritative root, local/workspace/CLI terms, no cloud/browser/auth/payment terms, deduplicated by name.
methodology.authority_basis: Publisher-owned repository or named expert/organization corpus; popularity is not used as authority.
methodology.normalization_plan: Extract visible task contract, workflow, verification, failure modes, resources, and provenance from the source skill.
methodology.verification_plan: Derive semantic checks from the source procedure and task contract; freeze assertions before review.
methodology.task_generation_plan: Seed normal, edge, missing-input, tool-failure, near-miss, and negative task cards.
methodology.review: Two independent reviewers required: domain expert and user advocate.
methodology.benchmark: Candidate only; not runnable as gold.

environment.notes: Heuristic environment classification; verify against the source skill.

access.notes: Heuristic classification; verify against the source skill before use.

review.notes: Local-first candidate; normalization, verification, evals, and review pending.
